title: Words of Radiance
summary: As the Everstorm gathers and the Voidbringer threat grows imminent, Kaladin must master his newfound powers as a Windrunner of the Knights Radiant while protecting the members of Bridge Four. Shallan Davar, a young woman hiding a traumatic past and a fractured psyche, journeys to the Shattered Plains to infiltrate the Ghostbloods and unlock the secrets of the Knights Radiant—including the nature of the Lost Radiants and the true purpose of the Oathgate. The Parshendi prepare to summon the Everstorm, and Dalinar must unite the quarreling highprinces through the ancient code of the Alethi war camps. First ideals are sworn, Shardblades are challenged, and two broken people must learn to trust each other before the world ends. The Radiants have returned—but will they be enough?
archiveDescription: This second volume of the Rosharan chronicle follows the consolidation of the nascent Radiant orders as the Everstorm approaches and the conflict with the Parshendi intensifies. The record examines the Second Ideal of the Radiants and the powers it grants, as well as the political machinations within the Alethi warcamp on the Shattered Plains. A young woman's investigation into the Ghostbloods and her own fractured identity reveals connections between the Lost Radiants, the Oathgates, and the true history of human settlement on Roshar. The volume concludes with a formal challenge to the seat of power itself.
